item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 21/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a fresh to strong northeast monsoon, the weather will be cool over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow morning. A replenishment of the monsoon will reach the coast of southern China on Sunday. Temperatures over the region will fall later. It will be rather cool on Monday morning. The monsoon will moderate gradually midweek next week. Temperatures over the coastal areas will rise slightly. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will bring a few rain patches to the region. A mild and humid maritime airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week. It will be misty over the region.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 16 - 18 C
R.H. range: 70 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
